plaatsen.tekst: Then he found another man, and said, Smite me, I pray thee. And the man smote him, so that in smiting he wounded him.
The watchmen that went about the city found me, they smote me, they wounded me; the keepers of the walls took away my veil
He that is wounded in the stones, or hath his privy member cut off, shall not enter into the congregation of the LORD.
